title: The Blog Entry

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I found something!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I found something!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: A blog entry in the Old Network about cryogenics.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A blog entry in the Old Network about cryogenics.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I hope we don't have LifeCorp on our heels now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope we don't have LifeCorp on our heels now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I hope we don't have LifeCorp on our heels now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I hope we don't have LifeCorp on our heels now.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: LifeCorp has no clue the Old Network is still there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: LifeCorp has no clue the Old Network is still there.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: But it is a dark and wild place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But it is a dark and wild place.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Great! What did you find?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great! What did you find?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I found something useful. Cryogenics had a problem. The cryogeneticists never found a way to preserve complex nerve system during revival.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I found something useful. Cryogenics had a problem. The cryogeneticists never found a way to preserve complex nerve system during revival.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just make sure you aren't tracked when searching the Deep Nets.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just make sure you aren't tracked when searching the Deep Nets.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just make sure you aren't tracked when searching the Deep Nets.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just make sure you aren't tracked when searching the Deep Nets.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The cell damage was subtle, but serious. LifeCorp kept it secret to make sure the investors kept paying.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The cell damage was subtle, but serious. LifeCorp kept it secret to make sure the investors kept paying.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: When the truth leaked, it nearly killed the company. Investors withdrew, the stocks hit rock-bottom.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When the truth leaked, it nearly killed the company. Investors withdrew, the stocks hit rock-bottom.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Never been so sad about a "nearly".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never been so sad about a "nearly".
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Never been so sad about a "nearly".
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Never been so sad about a "nearly".

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Phew. We were lucky.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Phew. We were lucky.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The financial fallout was awful. As ever, it was the poorest who suffered the most.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The financial fallout was awful. As ever, it was the poorest who suffered the most.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened to all the bodies?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened to all the bodies?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What happened to all the bodies?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What happened to all the bodies?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: LifeCorp promised to take good care of them, but everyone just wanted to move on. To forget.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: LifeCorp promised to take good care of them, but everyone just wanted to move on. To forget.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Records from a long defunct salvage company shows that LifeCorp secretly destroyed them all at some point to safe money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Records from a long defunct salvage company shows that LifeCorp secretly destroyed them all at some point to safe money.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Damn....

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Damn....

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: So I can't be human... I would have been "destroyed".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I can't be human... I would have been "destroyed".

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I thought you were on to something too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry. I thought you were on to something too.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sorry. I thought you were on to something too.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sorry. I thought you were on to something too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I fear we both knew this was the case.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I fear we both knew this was the case.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I fear we both knew this was the case.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I fear we both knew this was the case.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I still want to know everything about it. Maybe we can bring LifeCorp down?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I still want to know everything about it. Maybe we can bring LifeCorp down?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's the spirit!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the spirit!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think that's realistic. Or helpful.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think that's realistic. Or helpful.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think that's realistic. Or helpful.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think that's realistic. Or helpful.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The currency collapsed. Many couldn't afford food. Hundreds of billions of Lims had to be written off.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The currency collapsed. Many couldn't afford food. Hundreds of billions of Lims had to be written off.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm listening.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm listening.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Destroyed as in... killed?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Destroyed as in... killed?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Apparently.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Apparently.
